452                    SANSKRIT GRAMMAR.                    [§777

र्—denoting 'the agent' is added to—पच् and other roots; पचतीति पच्: 'one who cooks;' भर्—भर:, भुर्—भीर: सृ—सर:, नह्—नह: (नही);—to भू and पच्, when the words जार and भक्त are prefixed to them respectively; जारभूत 'an adulteress,' भक्तपच: 'a Chāṇḍāla'—to हृ when the noun governed by it is used prepositionally and when the idea of difficulty is not present or when the whole compound denotes 'age,' अंशं हृतीति अंशहर: 'one entitled to a share, a heir'; but भारहार: 'a load-bearer' (भार+हृ+अर्); कलहर: 'a young child;' also when भा is prefixed to it in the sense of 'in the habit of,' शस्त्रादि हृते शीलमस्य असौ शस्त्रहर:;—to the root गृहृ when the words शक्ति 'a missile,' लाङ्गल 'a plough,' अङ्कुश 'an iron hook,' तोमर 'a javelin,' याष्टि 'a stick,' घट, घटी and घटुध are prefixed to it; शक्ति गृह्णातीति शक्तिगृह: 'one armed with a spear,' &c; लाङ्गलगृह: &c.; also when सूत्र is prefixed to it and the root is used in the sense of 'wearing'; सूत्रगृह: 'wearing a sacred thread,' but सूत्रग्राह: (सूत्र+गृहृ+अर्) 'one who takes in his hand a sacred thread;'—to अर्ह् when a noun used objectively is prefixed to it; पूजामर्हतीति पूजार्हो ब्राह्मण: 'a Brāhmaṇa deserving worship,' —to रु and जप् when the words स्तम्भ and कर्ण in the Loc. are prefixed to them respectively; स्तम्भेरु: 'an elephant,' कर्णेजप: 'one who whispers into the ear, a spy;'—to any root when the word शं is prefixed, शंकर:, शंभव:, शंवद: &c.—to शी when a word showing the place of action precedes, खे शेते ख-(खे)शय: 'dwelling in the sky,' so हृच्छय: 'dwelling in the heart, i. e Madana'; also when words like पार्श्वे उदर, पृष्ठ, &c. and उत्तान, &c. precede, पार्श्वे—उदर—पृष्ठ—शय: 'sleeping on the sides,' &c., उत्तानशय: 'lying on the back with the face upwards.' so अधःशंशय: (अवनतो मूर्धा अस्य तथा शेते) i. e. 'with the face downwards.' When added to roots ending in र and to some others it forms abstract nouns, क्षि—क्षय: 'a collection,' नि—जय:, भी—भय:, दृश्—दर्ष: 'a shower of rain.' &c.
